title: The Last Train Home
overview: Graduate student Amara Ellis did not arrive home after leaving the campus library. Her phone went offline near the central station, and friends report no recent conflict.
objective: Build a reliable timeline, evaluate the last confirmed sighting, and identify the most credible explanation for Amara's disappearance.

hypotheses.statement: Amara missed her train after assisting an injured passenger and later contacted a friend from a nearby station.
Amara left voluntarily to avoid her research group after a disagreement.

evidence.title: Missing person intake
evidence.content: Amara left the campus library at 8:32 PM and did not arrive at her shared apartment. Her phone last connected near Central Station.

evidence.title: Library exit camera summary
evidence.content: Amara left carrying her backpack and walked toward the westbound bus stop. She appeared calm and used her transit card.

evidence.title: Station service log
evidence.content: A medical assistance call at Central Station delayed the 8:50 PM train. A passenger described a student matching Amara's clothing helping station staff.

evidence.title: Transit card history
evidence.content: Amara's card was tapped at the neighboring Riverside station at 9:26 PM, after the Central Station delay.

evidence.title: Friend's message
evidence.content: At 9:41 PM, Amara messaged her friend: 'Train issue. Helping someone at Central; heading over to Riverside now. Battery low.'

suspects.name: No person of interest identified
suspects.role: Available evidence points to a travel disruption rather than an abduction

witness_statements.statement: A student matching Amara's clothing helped station staff during a medical assistance call.
Amara said she was delayed while helping someone and was heading to Riverside.

timeline.event: A medical call delayed the train at Central Station.
Amara's transit card was used at Riverside station.
Amara messaged a friend that she was delayed and her battery was low.
